title: v1_114
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.114 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: April 1, 2026_ --- Welcome to the 1.114 release of Visual Studio Code. This release focuses on **streamlining your chat experience**. * [**Preview videos**](#preview-videos-in-the-image-carousel): preview videos in the image carousel for chat attachments and the Explorer context menu. * [**Copy chat response**](#copy-final-response-in-chat): copy the final Markdown chat response for easy sharing. * [**Troubleshooting chat**](#troubleshoot-previous-chat-sessions-preview): use `/troubleshoot` to diagnose chat customization issues in previous sessions. * [**Simplified workspace search**](#workspace-search-simplification): get faster, more consistent semantic search results. Happy Coding! ---
